question: Should OpenClaw accept this Z.ai OpenAI-compatible wire-contract update with BigModel/CN live proof as enough to land?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-backed, but it changes provider request payloads for existing Z.ai users and the live proof host is not the overseas global endpoint.

options.title: Accept current proof and land

options.title: Require global endpoint proof
options.body: Ask the contributor to add one redacted `api.z.ai` GLM-5.2 live run before merge, keeping the current patch shape.

options.title: Pause for provider-owner rewrite
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want the Z.ai plugin wrapper, not the shared provider builder, to own this mapping permanently.

recommendation.title: Accept current proof and land
